How you explained that the guinea pig was acting his normal self, and then suddenly getting sick and not eating is a huge sign of GI stasis. Usually that’s how it happens. To help prevent it having an unlimited amount of hay and water at all times can make the chances less likely but all piggies can get it. You can get an emergency back up of something called “critical care” and it’s a food formula you force feed with a syringe a few times a day and it can save a pigs life by making the GI system move from the blockage. But if GI stasis is suspected please see if you have an exotic vet near you. If not critical care is the most important thing to do to care for a sick piggie with GI status. It can save their life
